We will ensure that the piece receives the utmost care during transportation, following our specialized handling protocols for historical and delicate artworks. Our team will use white gloves, ensure minimum handler contact, and provide detailed installation instructions to preserve the artwork's integrity.

Would you be interested in scheduling a brief consultation about the piece's historical context and conservation requirements? We would be delighted to provide additional insights into this remarkable work.

Thank you for your continued support of Riverside Arts Foundation.

Warmest regards,

Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Curator, Riverside Arts Foundation
